The Blood of Dawnwalker Map Size: What Is Confirmed?

Exact size not announced

The exact map area has not been published in the official sources checked on August 26, 2026.

What is confirmed

The official site shows varied environments including forests, plains, swamps, mountains and settlements in an open-world setting.

What is not confirmed

There is no reliable official square-kilometre figure in the sources used for this page. Any precise number would currently be speculation.

Update plan

After release, this page can add a measured route comparison or an official map figure while preserving the source and test method.

This pre-release page separates official facts from unresolved questions. It will not invent hands-on results before the game is available.
